angle: Data-ownership-first: no comparison ends with missing data
thesis: Measure per-field completeness of today's pipeline first. Then build the owned KB (045) and a persisted registry carrying robots, ToS and blocked state. Seed it off-clock from the held corpora, the 24 feed hosts and ranked JSON-LD PDPs. Every compare writes back, and every miss becomes a kb_gaps row that a channel ladder fills, ending at the operator path. Inferred reach: 500 juices after the Bahrain feed walk, 2,000 after all feeds plus 71 JSON-LD hosts (no web_search), 10,000 only with write-back plus partner or licence data. Deferred: provider flip, quota, share, speed.

milestones.title: Inherited finish and the completeness baseline
milestones.goal: Merge B4 URL-MODE-V2 first (owner decision 1). Record the 'before' per-field completeness of today's pipeline and the inputs every later spec rests on (organic fragrance volume, 012 RLS, robots readability, CDX density). Without these, no fill can be shown to work.
milestones.exit_metric: B4 PR merged green. baseline_completeness.json in the s81 state folder gives per-field rates (identity, image, price+freshness, size, concentration, specs, rating, reviews) over the fixture corpus, each tagged measured or inferred and reproduced by a second agent. The owner SQL answers are logged as dated ledger lines.

milestones.title: Owned store, guards and the registry with blocked state (dark)
milestones.goal: Ship, all dark: migrations 045 kb_*, 047 012-REVOKE and 048 compare_runs; one DENY_HOSTS module and the guard fixes (Replica, infused, lv); kb_merchants read per call with status and blocked_reason; robots persisted off-clock for every live host as QarenBot; the per-field completeness ledger plus gap queue, so misses are recorded from the first post-approval flip.
milestones.exit_metric: 045/047/048 applied via PRECHECK/POSTCHECK. 275/275 live hosts carry a persisted robots verdict with fetched_at. 0 deny hosts reachable through the router, rating tiers, URL mode or any KB writer (pinned). field_status matches the D02 hand tally on 20 fixtures. Every flag-OFF identity pin is green.

milestones.title: Seed to 500, then 2,000 fragrances, off-clock
milestones.goal: Fill the KB without user traffic: held corpora, then a polite named-UA walk of the 24 feed hosts (14 Bahrain first, ranked by merchant count), then ranked PDPs on the 71 JSON-LD hosts, plus a Haiku Batch citation-or-omit spec extraction. R15 model (inferred, N=20k, s=1): 500 gives 65% single / 42% pair hits; 2,000 gives 78% / 61% (pessimistic 33/11 and 47/22). The pace is bounded by owner ToS verdicts, not crawl time: a 2 s delay allows about 43k requests per host per day.
milestones.exit_metric: Distinct fragrance juices in kb_products reach at least 500, then at least 2,000. Each has at least one offer from a robots-allow host with captured_at and a currency evidence rung. 0 rows from deny hosts. The first-20-row Haiku usage is logged, and the cost per juice is measured rather than assumed.

milestones.title: Every compare writes back; KB-first serve
milestones.goal: Delivered compares ingest cited facts after moderation. The KB card replaces the L2 read in one round trip. Robots is enforced on the live path from the persisted verdict. An out-of-process worker keeps prices fresh, so freshness is never paid inline. All of this flips only after approval, with the canary.
milestones.exit_metric: In the canary: KB read uses at most 1 Supabase round trip per product, and its p50 is measured. Ingest write failures are logged and below the agreed gate. A full-hit pair makes 0 Serper calls. No smoke20 regression and no rise in WINNER_INDEX_MISMATCH. robots_skip counts appear per host.

milestones.title: Gap loop: every miss becomes a fill
milestones.goal: Each missing required field on a delivered compare is a demand-ranked kb_gaps row. Nightly it walks the ladder: adapter search, then sitemap/CDX PDP, then capped web_search with registry allowed_domains, then the operator queue for blocked hosts, then the licence queue for notes and longevity. A weekly coverage report compares real hit rates against the R15 path to 10,000 (93% / 87%).
milestones.exit_metric: Reconciling compare_runs against kb_gaps shows 100% gap capture. Fill rate is reported per channel each week. One blocked-host gap is filled end to end through the operator path on staging. The weekly report sets the measured pair hit rate beside the model and states n.

milestones.title: Honest surfaces, fragrance gate, B2 on the new brain, legal
milestones.goal: The UI shows an honest 'unknown' with its reason, plus a price as-of date. The fragrance-only gate is zero-cost. B2 abstains only when KB plus live evidence cannot support a winner, and every abstain writes gaps. The legal unit discloses the KB, operator capture, crawler identity and Anthropic in one consent window.
milestones.exit_metric: A 50-compare audit finds 0 fabricated values (rating, count, percentage, price). Every missing field renders the honest line in EN and AR. The legal docs and consent v3 are live before any Anthropic, gate or ledger flip. B2 flips only after D18 reports the pair hit rate.

units.title: FLIP-CANARY measurement: ingest, first-serve, live robots, gate
units.scope: After approval and D21, owner-run canaries one flag per window in this order: B1, COMPLETENESS_LEDGER, SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD, KB_INGEST, KB_FIRST_SERVE (then SEARCH_SKIP), LIVE_ROBOTS_REGISTRY, FRAGRANCE_ONLY_GATE, RESULT_GATE. Each window records KB read p50 and round trips, ingest failures, smoke20, WINNER_INDEX_MISMATCH, per-field completeness against the D02 baseline, Serper calls saved per 100 compares, and robots_skip per host. Two failed gates mean rollback (flag OFF).
tests: each window records measured values with n and the timestamp of the flag change
the rollback criterion is stated before the flip
the smoke and eval harness is exempt from quotas and tagged synthetic
no production configuration read by agents (names only, owner-run)
units.risk: Low compare volume makes single-window canaries noisy; the report states n and extends the window rather than inferring.

cut_or_deferred: Live provider adapter, text-role flip, Haiku moderation and camera on Claude: handed to the parallel cost/speed lane (files openai_service, model_config, extraction_service and llm_adapter are disjoint). This plan adds only the SDK pin and the off-clock Batch path in D10.
Device quota, auth throttles and the fingerprint OTA: quota lane. D18 uses the device key when the header exists and falls back to the account key otherwise.
Per-platform share flow, landing OG and app startup/bundle speed: second orchestrator lane after M3. They do not touch data files and do not affect completeness.
Verdict cache, SSE per-product events and the critique/judge loop (feedback migration 046): later lanes. They consume compare_runs from D05, so they come after it.
Skincare and makeup data (OBF in a separate ODbL table): deferred until fragrance coverage passes 2,000 juices and the chips flip. Fragrance is the only live category.
Splink merging, the extruct fallback and the Shopify UCP MCP probe: deferred. Deterministic kb_identity comes first; UCP needs the owner's agent profile and Shopify terms.
Notes and longevity beyond merchant-cited text: no engineering before a written licence (CJ, Fragrances of the World). These fields stay an honest unknown routed to needs_licence.
Trustpilot, Bazaarvoice and partner review keys: contract-gated through the store CTA programme. Only JSON-LD AggregateRating ships (D08).
owner_actions: Approve this plan and confirm that B4 finishes first, with D01 as the opening unit in backend-A and D03 in parallel in backend-B.

Run the read-only SQL and names-only checks for D02: organic fragrance volume and repeat-pair share in search_logs, product_prices row count, pg_policies on the three 012 tables, and whether ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD, ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are set on web and the cron services (names only).
Decide on the Common Crawl Terms for CDX discovery. If you decline, D11 runs on sitemaps only.

Review ToS per host and record tos_reviewed_at, verdict and terms_url: the 14 Bahrain feed hosts first, then the 10 GCC feed hosts, then the 71 JSON-LD hosts, and each blocked host before any operator capture.
Apply migrations 045, 047 (only after the live pg_policies read) and 048 via the SQL-editor PRECHECK/POSTCHECK flow after each PR merges.
Create the Anthropic Console workspace with the $400 limit and web search restricted, and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the cron and worker services only (names only, never in the repo).

Register the Railway cron services (robots registry, feed walk, PDP discovery, spec batch, gap fill, coverage rollup) and the KB refresh worker service. Flip ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD under its canary before any KB flag.
After App Review approval: publish D21 with the consent v3 OTA in one window, then run the D22 flip order one canary at a time, then ship the D20 client OTA.
Rule on the live adapter user agent once D09's dry-run has measured capture under QarenBot, and rule on decant-house handling.

Licence and partner track: the FragranceX CJ application, a Fragrances of the World licence request, partner feeds and review keys through the store CTA contract (Golden Scent, Nice One, Faces), and counsel answers on image hotlinking and stale-price display.
